synthesis.evidence_balance: mixed — a still-growing, unlevered franchise versus a margin/EBITDA step-down, cash burn, and an NTM EBITDA multiple implying a forward earnings collapse.

bull_points.claim: Revenue compounded from $261M (FY2021) to $784M LTM with +15.4% same-quarter YoY growth in the latest quarter, far outpacing the peer-median 4% growth — a still-growing top line, not a melting one.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement + Segments + Ratios (multi-year columns)

bull_points.claim: Absolute EBITDA rose from $4M (FY2021) to $103M (FY2025), and the EBITDA margin % reached 14% in FY2025 before the LTM 10% print — read together, the business has been scaling profitably, not deteriorating.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

bull_points.claim: The balance sheet is essentially unlevered: net-debt/EBITDA 0.0x, net-debt/OCF 0.3x, and interest coverage 99.4x, with the nearest maturity wall not until 2029 and the revolver undrawn.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Net Debt $3M [Q1 Mar-29-2026] ÷ CIQ EBITDA $80M [LTM 12 months Mar-29-2026]

bull_points.claim: On fundamental_deltas the name shows stronger revenue growth (26% vs 4%), positive EBITDA growth (6% vs peer-median -11%), and far lower leverage (0.1 vs 3.8) than peers — posing whether the TEV/EBITDA discount (1.2x vs peer-median 7.2x) is RESIDUAL/overshoot rather than EARNED, though the peer set is heterogeneous.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Operating Statistics (name vs peer median: growth/margin/leverage/beta)

bull_points.claim: Management authorized a $100M share repurchase program at the Feb-2026 gap-down and the share count is essentially flat (-0.6% over ~1.7y), indicating no dilution and a capital-return signal.
bull_points.source_ref: EDGAR 8-K item codes at the gap-down dates (not blanket-labelled earnings)

bull_points.claim: Consensus carries an Outperform (2.00) recommendation with a mean target of $11.67 versus the heavily de-rated stock, and FY2026 estimates show no downward revisions in the last month (0↑/0↓).

bear_points.claim: LTM free cash flow is -$53.9M and FCF sign is negative — the company is burning cash even as it scales, with cash-runway not derivable from the supplied facts.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Cash Flow 'Levered Free Cash Flow' [LTM 12 months Mar-29-2026]

bear_points.claim: The LTM EBITDA margin fell to 10% from 14% (FY2025) and absolute LTM EBITDA dropped to $79M from $103M — here the % decline is the REAL signal, not an optical misread, because the absolute EBITDA fell alongside it.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

bear_points.claim: The drawdown was driven by discrete event-coded 8-Ks: a Feb-2026 founder/Executive-Chairperson departure (5.02) and a May-2026 decision to wind down the butter product line entirely (2.05) — concrete idiosyncratic events, not market noise.
bear_points.source_ref: EDGAR 8-K item codes at the gap-down dates (not blanket-labelled earnings)

bear_points.claim: The business is wholly undiversified — 100% of revenue from Eggs and Butter and 100% US — and is now narrowing further by discontinuing butter, concentrating the entire franchise in a single egg category.
The name massively underperformed: -69.2% over 180 days versus IWM +18.0%, a -86.8% relative move, confirming a sharp idiosyncratic de-rating.

On the forward basis the optical cheapness inverts: NTM TEV/EBITDA is 70.81 vs peer-median 8.98 and NTM P/E is NM (negative base) — the forward multiple is expensive, not cheap, signalling a sharp expected earnings collapse.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Trading Multiples (name row + Summary Statistics Low/Median/Mean/High)
